info.title: DNCS API
info.description: Contract for the implemented P0-P6 API plus post-P6 account recovery commands, including request tracing, bounded JSON input, authentication throttling and stable error metadata. Role/permission administration remains intentionally deferred.

x-hardening.request_id: X-Request-ID accepts a canonical UUID or is replaced by a generated UUID; every response returns it.
x-hardening.correlation_id: X-Correlation-ID accepts a canonical UUID, defaults to request_id, and is copied into required audit rows.
x-hardening.authentication_rate_limit: Configured fixed window per direct peer IP and authentication route; 429 includes Retry-After and RateLimit headers.
x-hardening.request_timeout: Configured server-side context deadline; an unwritten expired response is 504 REQUEST_TIMEOUT.
x-hardening.redaction: Request query, authorization headers, bodies, credentials, raw peer IP and non-allowlisted or prohibited audit fields are not logged or persisted in audit snapshots.
